get.description: Never touches the database, so monitoring does not wake Neon (ADR-008).
For the checks after a deploy. Limited per IP.
Public. A revoked, expired or unknown link answers 410 INVITATION_INVALID; an accepted one answers with status accepted.

post.summary: U5 Sign up through an invitation
post.description: Public, limited per IP with the sign-in paths. Creates the account for the invitation's address and answers signed in. An invitation to a workspace stays pending until U6.
Only for the account with the invitation's address. Joins the workspace with the invitation's role, or keeps the role of an existing member.

patch.description: Changes only the fields sent. lastWorkspaceId must be one of the caller's workspaces.

put.description: multipart/form-data with the photo as file: a JPEG, PNG or WebP image of at most 5 MB, told by its content. Stored as a 512×512 WebP.

post.description: Confirms with the address, and the password or a sign-in within the last 10 minutes. Refuses with LAST_OWNER while the caller is the only Owner of a workspace with other members.
For an account that signed up with Google only, within 10 minutes of signing in. Ends every other session.
The caller becomes its Owner and lands on it. The currency defaults to PHP.

patch.summary: W1 Change a workspace's name or currency
patch.description: Owner only. Amounts are not converted.

get.summary: W2 The members of a workspace
get.description: In the order they joined. Only an Owner gets the addresses.

patch.description: Owner only. Becoming a Viewer ends the member's self-analysis share here and names them in free text on their execution items.

delete.summary: W3 Remove a member, or leave
delete.description: An Owner removes anyone; every member may leave with userId me. Ends the member's self-analysis share here and names them in free text on their execution items.

get.summary: W8 Whom a comment may mention
get.description: Every member, Viewers included. On a self-analysis answer (targetKey is its question), only the Owners and Members of a workspace it is shared with, and Viewers may not ask.

get.summary: W4 The invitations of a workspace
get.description: Owner only, newest first. status=pending (the default) lists those that can still be accepted; all adds accepted, revoked and expired ones.

post.summary: W4 Invite someone to a workspace
post.description: Owner only. Mails the link to the address and never returns it. 503 UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE when the mail cannot be sent, and then no invitation is made.

An Owner of the invitation's workspace, or an operator for any invitation. Makes a new link, ending the old one, and a new expiry. Expired invitations may be resent. Refuses with ALREADY_MEMBER and INVITATION_PENDING as W4 does.

delete.description: An Owner of the invitation's workspace, or an operator for any invitation.

get.description: Better Auth decides the paths, bodies and answers (SDD 5.4). Errors come in its { code, message } shape (SDD 8.1).

post.description: Better Auth decides the paths, bodies and answers (SDD 5.4). Errors come in its { code, message } shape (SDD 8.1).
